output.one_liner: Zendesk is a cloud-based customer service platform that unifies support tickets across multiple channels.

auth.notes: OAuth2 is the primary method via Bearer tokens in Authorization headers. Basic authentication with API tokens is deprecated. Global OAuth tokens required for distributing apps to multiple Zendesk customers.

evidence.snippet: In your requests, specify the access token in an Authorization header as follows
Basic authentication is used for API tokens. The credentials must be sent with the request in an Authorization header.
Use your own Zendesk OAuth client when you want users to see your app's name on the consent screen

access.notes: Developers can sign up for a 14-day free trial without credit card or approval. Full API access during trial; paid plan required after expiration.

evidence.snippet: Create a developer account. Try out the Sunshine Platform with a free, 14-day trial account.
14-day free trial. No credit card required.

api_surface.rate_limit_note: Rate limits documented as requests per minute, but specific allowances not stated in provided pages.

evidence.snippet: Zendesk's APIs are organized around REST principles. Our APIs have resource-oriented URLs
Webhooks let you build or set up integrations that subscribe to certain activity in Zendesk Support, Guide, Gather, and Messaging.
For information on the number of requests allowed per minute, see Rate limits

buildability.rationale: Composio already built a 484-tool production-ready toolkit with self-serve OAuth2 and comprehensive REST API documentation.

overview_evidence.snippet: Zendesk Ticketing brings email, messaging, phone, social and more into a single place. With AI automations and simple admin tools.
Go beyond answers to improve customer and employee experiences with the Zendesk Outcome AI™ Platform.
